storyTitle: Joseph and His Brothers in Egypt

start.title: Famine in the Land
start.text:
Foreigners come daily for grain.
A new group bows before your dais.

choices.text: Wave them off, you are busy

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:6-7 — Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them.

wave_consequence.title: Look Again
wave_consequence.text:
Something pulls your eye back.
Those beards, that posture…

choices.feedback: You step down from the dais.

demand_consequence.title: Steady Yourself
demand_consequence.text:
Their voices reach you. Hebrew.
Your heart begins to pound.

recognize.title: It Is Them
recognize.text:
Reuben. Judah. Levi. All ten.
They do not know you.

choices.text: Hide your face and test them
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:7 — Joseph recognized his brothers but did not reveal himself, instead treating them as strangers.

reveal_consequence.title: Too Soon
reveal_consequence.text:
Their hearts are not yet known.
Is Benjamin safe? Is father alive?

choices.text: Hide your face and test them

arrest_consequence.title: A Cold Heart
arrest_consequence.text:
Anger burns — but God put you here
for more than revenge.

choices.text: Hide your face and test them

hide_face.title: A Stranger's Voice
hide_face.text:
Through an interpreter you speak harsh.
"Where do you come from?"

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:7 — Joseph spoke harshly to his brothers and asked where they came from.

skip_consequence.title: Hold the Plan
skip_consequence.text:
If you skip the test now,
you will never know their hearts.

spy_accusation.title: "You Are Spies!"
spy_accusation.text:
You point and roar the word.
The brothers fall to their knees.

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:9 — Joseph remembered his dreams about them and accused his brothers of being spies.

smile_consequence.title: Mask On
smile_consequence.text:
You must not soften yet.
The test is only beginning.

they_protest.title: Their Defense
they_protest.text:
"We are twelve sons. One is no more.
The youngest is with our father."

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:13 — The brothers told Joseph they were twelve brothers, one was no more, and the youngest was with their father.

pretend_consequence.title: Steady
pretend_consequence.text:
Without Benjamin, the test fails.
You must press on.

mock_consequence.title: Bite Your Tongue
mock_consequence.text:
Mocking the lost wounds father too.
You pull the words back.

demand_benjamin.title: Three Days' Hold
demand_benjamin.text:
"You will be held three days.
Then one fetches the youngest."

choices.text: Lock them all in the chamber
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:15 — Joseph demanded that his brothers bring their youngest brother to him to prove their words.

free_consequence.title: Hold the Line
free_consequence.text:
Without pressure, the truth hides.
Three days will reveal much.

choices.text: Lock them all in the chamber

three_days.title: Third Morning
three_days.text:
Three days have weighed on them.
Now you offer a softer terms.

choices.text: Keep one, send the rest with grain
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:17-19 — After three days, Joseph proposed that one brother remain imprisoned while the others returned with grain and brought their youngest brother.

all_stay_consequence.title: Be Just
all_stay_consequence.text:
Their wives and children would die.
God would not honor that.

choices.text: Keep one, send the rest with grain

keep_one.title: Their Confession
keep_one.text:
They speak among themselves, not knowing
you understand every word.

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:21-23 — Joseph's brothers spoke among themselves about their guilt concerning Joseph, not knowing he understood them.

ignore_consequence.title: Listen
ignore_consequence.text:
These are the words you waited
twenty years to hear.

overhear.title: "This Is For Joseph"
overhear.text:
"We sinned against our brother.
We saw his anguish and would not hear."

choices.text: Show your tears in front of them

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:24 — Joseph turned away from his brothers and wept.

tears_open_consequence.title: Not Yet
tears_open_consequence.text:
They would see and the test
would be undone too soon.

weep_alone.title: Choose Simeon
weep_alone.text:
You return composed. Now choose
which brother to hold.

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:24 — Joseph took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.

reuben_consequence.title: Not Reuben
reuben_consequence.text:
Reuben spoke for you long ago.
Let justice fall on another.

bind_simeon.title: Simeon Bound
bind_simeon.text:
Ropes circle his wrists. He goes
without protest. The brothers pale.

choices.text: Order their sacks filled with grain
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:25 — Joseph gave orders to fill his brothers' sacks with grain.

choices.text: Send them empty, to teach a lesson

empty_consequence.title: Mercy Returns
empty_consequence.text:
Famine kills children too.
Give them what they came for.

choices.text: Order their sacks filled with grain

fill_sacks.title: Silver Returned
fill_sacks.text:
You whisper to the steward:
"Put each man's silver back in his sack."

choices.text: Take the silver as fair pay
Hide it deep within the grain
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:25 — Joseph commanded that every man's silver be put back into his sack.

choices.text: Toss it openly into their cart

silver_consequence.title: No Profit
silver_consequence.text:
You will not take from your father's house.
Return it in secret.

choices.text: Hide it deep within the grain

open_consequence.title: Hidden, Not Open
open_consequence.text:
An open gift would frighten them.
Better discovered later.

choices.text: Hide it deep within the grain

silver_hidden.title: Provision for the Road
silver_hidden.text:
The steward also packs food
for the long journey home.

choices.text: Send them off with no warning

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:20 — Joseph told his brothers that they must bring their youngest brother to him.

no_warning_consequence.title: Make It Clear
no_warning_consequence.text:
If they forget the terms,
the test cannot be completed.

send_off.title: They Depart
send_off.text:
Donkeys laden, the nine ride out.
From your window, you watch.

choices.text: Run after them and confess all

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:25 — Joseph also gave them provisions for their journey.

run_consequence.title: Hold the Plan
run_consequence.text:
Father's heart, Benjamin's safety —
the test must be finished.

first_camp.title: Camp at Dusk
first_camp.text:
Far away, the brothers stop.
One opens his sack for grain.

silver_found.title: "What Has God Done?"
silver_found.text:
They tremble. "What is this God
has done to us?" they cry.

choices.text: They will turn back in panic

press_on.title: Onward to Canaan
press_on.text:
Fear pushes them home.
Father is waiting.

choices.feedback: Genesis 42:29-34 — The brothers returned to Jacob and told him all that had happened.

hide_consequence.title: Speak True
hide_consequence.text:
Father will see the missing son.
A lie will only deepen the pain.

tell_jacob.title: Father Hears
tell_jacob.text:
Jacob's hand trembles at his chest.
"Joseph is gone. Simeon now too…"

choices.feedback: Genesis 43:9 — Reuben offered his two sons as collateral for Benjamin's safe return, but Judah later promised to be surety for Benjamin.

argue_consequence.title: Be Gentle
argue_consequence.text:
Shouting will not heal a father
who has buried a son in his heart.

walk_consequence.title: Stay With Him
walk_consequence.text:
Leaving solves nothing.
Father needs a steady son now.

promise_jacob.title: Jacob Refuses
promise_jacob.text:
"My son shall not go down with you."
The grain bag empties slowly.

choices.feedback: Wait for the famine to speak.

choices.text: Wait until the grain runs out
choices.feedback: Genesis 42:38 — Jacob refused to let Benjamin go, fearing harm would come to him like Joseph.

force_consequence.title: Patience
force_consequence.text:
Father will not be forced.
God's time will come.

choices.text: Wait until the grain runs out

wait_famine.title: Sacks Run Empty
wait_famine.text:
Weeks pass. The last grain is gone.
Father summons his sons.

choices.text: Stay silent and let Reuben speak
choices.feedback: Genesis 43:8 — Judah spoke to Jacob, convincing him to let Benjamin go so they would not starve.

choices.text: Boast you can fix it alone

boast_consequence.title: Quiet, Brother
boast_consequence.text:
Father needs a pledge, not a boast.
Let Judah speak.

choices.text: Stay silent and let Judah speak

judah_speaks.title: Judah's Pledge
judah_speaks.text:
"Send the boy with me. I will be
surety. On me alone the blame."

choices.feedback: His pledge is a true one.
Genesis 43:9 — Judah pledged himself as surety for Benjamin's safe return to Jacob.

mock_judah_consequence.title: Hush
mock_judah_consequence.text:
This is the moment of pledge.
Do not break it with mockery.

father_relents.title: "If I Am Bereaved…"
father_relents.text:
"Take double silver. Take a gift.
And may God Almighty give you mercy."

choices.feedback: Father said double — and a gift.

choices.text: Prepare double silver and a gift
choices.feedback: Genesis 43:11-12 — Jacob instructed his sons to take double money and a gift to the man in Egypt.

stingy_consequence.title: Honor Father
stingy_consequence.text:
Father has spoken with care.
Obey him in full.

choices.text: Prepare double silver and a gift

preparation.title: Donkeys Loaded
preparation.text:
Benjamin tightens his sash.
The road south waits in the dust.

choices.feedback: Genesis 43:14 — Jacob prayed that God Almighty would grant his sons mercy before they departed for Egypt.

no_pray_consequence.title: Pray First
no_pray_consequence.text:
Egypt is far. The vizier is harsh.
Ask God's mercy now.

ending.title: Toward Egypt Again
ending.text:
Eleven brothers ride south.
A strange vizier waits — and watches.
